column5: A sixteen-year-old girl underwent extensive exorcisms at a Jesuit chapel in Vienna after allegedly being possessed by more than 12, 000 demons. Following the extraction of the entities, her grandmother was accused of witchcraft, tortured, and executed

During a 19th-century spiritualist investigation at a historic house in Bruges, a visiting medium was violently possessed by the earthbound entity of a 15th-century monk. The possessing spirit re-enacted a heinous murder he had committed centuries prior within the building's walls.

column3: The Mass Possession Panic at Big Falls School
column5: In May 2007, a wave of violent and inexplicable possession episodes struck students and teachers at a village primary school in southern Belize, forcing its closure and specialized spiritual intervention.

column3: The Possession of José in San Pedro Cave
column5: In February 1991, a young boy named José became possessed by a malevolent entity after exploring a forbidden cave on Cerro San Pedro in Oruro, Bolivia, leading to a harrowing, multi-hour exorcism.

In 1660 New France, a teenage girl named Barbe Hallay was allegedly possessed by demons and tormented by hellish spectres after a rejected suitor sought revenge through sorcery. Plagued by violent outbursts and foreign voices, she was later subjected to years of intense exorcisms by nuns at a Quebec hospital.

Twenty-two schoolgirls in Colombia suffered violent seizures, hallucinations, and apparent demonic possession after playing the "Charlie Charlie" pencil game. Rushed to a local medical center foaming at the mouth, the victims described terrifying visions of a menacing man dressed in black.

In 1682, the parish priest of Remedios documented that a local woman named Leonarda was possessed by Lucifer, who spoke through her during formal ecclesiastical proceedings. The resulting panic prompted unsuccessful attempts by church authorities to relocate the entire town.
Between 1608 and 1615, a wealthy merchant's household in Denmark endured years of demonic haunting and spirit possession that culminated in a devastating witch trial.

column3: The Exorcism of Teresa on Moqattam Hill
column5: During a public Thursday evening service, a young woman named Teresa was brought before Father Samaan Ibrahim to be freed from multiple demons that had taken possession of her body.

column3: The Exorcism of the Young Student at Santo Tomás Church
column5: Father Raymundo Brizuela performed a grueling exorcism at Santo Tomás Church on a 21-year-old university student from Chalatenango who was taken over by an entity that altered her voice and required multiple priests and men to restrain her.

column3: The Demonic Fall of St. Olaf's Builder
column5: During the construction of St. Olaf's Church in st, a mysterious master builder plunged to his death from the spire, after which a snake and a toad crawled from his mouth as proof of his diabolical possession.

column3: The Spirit Possession at Nacavanadi Church
column5: During a prayer service in an island village, a congregant became possessed by a spirit that falsely accused a local homeowner of practicing witchcraft. Prompted by the entity's claims, the minister and villagers destroyed the targeted house, leading to a landmark court ruling against the church.

column3: The Demonic Possession of the Ursuline Nuns of Loudun
column5: In 1632, an entire community of Ursuline nuns at a convent in Loudun, France, fell victim to violent mass demonic possession, allegedly orchestrated by a local parish priest. The ensuing public exorcisms and witchcraft trials gripped the region and ended in a tragic execution.

column3: The Jinneh Possession Outbreak at Ming Daw School
column5: Dozens of teenage students at a Gambian secondary school were suddenly overtaken by malevolent spirits, exhibiting violent convulsions and unnatural superhuman strength.

column3: The Exorcism of the Student at the Monastery of Saint Gerasimos
column5: A seventeen-year-old student afflicted by an unclean spirit was brought to a historic island monastery in Greece where he was successfully exorcised before the relics of a revered ascetic. The account was documented in a mid-twentieth-century Greek newspaper.

Following the death of a traveler who left forbidden bed linen at an isolated farm, a terrifying wave of fatal hauntings and a supernaturally animated seal terrorized the household. The malevolent entities were finally banished when a priest conducted formal door-doom exorcisms and burned the cursed textiles.
During a medieval gathering of witches, the Devil possessed the young novices of a nearby convent and used them to corrupt the monks of the Principato di Lucedio into a century of dark rituals.

During a morning devotion led by a teacher warning that God was displeased, multiple students at a Jamaican high school suddenly collapsed, spoke in strange voices, and exhibited signs of demonic possession that required fervent spiritual deliverance.

A one-eyed, three-legged fox spirit named Otora Gitsune possessed numerous villagers in Japan, starting with a young woman named Otora. Victims exhibited strange physical ailments and endlessly recounted battle memories they never experienced until the spirit was eventually slain by a hunter.
